description: Add a fourth simulation profile 'steady' that keeps a metric at its current value with no automatic variation. The value is static over time but remains manually adjustable by the operator. Covers enum, sim_task skip logic, config_loader parsing, JSON config update, and a test-case on the raw tank flowIn metric.

userStories.title: Add SIM_STEADY enum and no-op skip logic in sim_task
userStories.description: As a firmware developer, I need the SimProfile enum to include SIM_STEADY and sim_metric() to skip value mutation for steady metrics so that the published value never changes between ticks.
acceptanceCriteria: SimProfile enum in main/ui/data.h has SIM_STEADY added as the last value: typedef enum { SIM_RANDOM_WALK = 0, SIM_SINE, SIM_RAMP, SIM_STEADY } SimProfile;
sim_metric() in sim_task.c does not call metric_push() when sim_profile == SIM_STEADY — preferred: wrap the metric_push call in if (m->sim_profile != SIM_STEADY) after the switch
case SIM_STEADY: is present in the switch (even if just a break) to suppress compiler warnings about unhandled enum values
idf.py build succeeds with zero new warnings

userStories.title: Parse 'steady' string in config_loader.c
userStories.description: As a firmware developer, I need config_loader.c to map the JSON string 'steady' to SIM_STEADY so that configs using the new profile are loaded correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: config_loader.c has an explicit else if (!strcmp(v->valuestring, "steady")) m->sim_profile = SIM_STEADY; branch in the profile-parsing block
The new branch is placed before the catch-all fallback that maps unknown strings to SIM_RANDOM_WALK
Existing branches for 'sine' and 'ramp' are unchanged
idf.py build succeeds with zero new warnings

userStories.title: Set raw tank flowIn metric to 'steady' in sapdm_config.json
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I want the raw tank's flowIn metric set to steady in the JSON config so the fix can be verified by flashing and observing MQTT output.
acceptanceCriteria: In main/spiffs_image/sapdm_config.json, the flowIn metric inside the 'raw' tank entry has its sim object changed to {"profile":"steady"} — no other sim fields needed
sapdm_config.annotated.json has the same change applied with a brief inline comment noting that 'steady' means no automatic variation
Both JSON files are valid (no syntax errors — verify with python3 -c 'import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))' on each file)

userStories.title: Verify default_config.c needs no change
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to confirm that default_config.c is consistent with the new enum and does not require updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Read default_config.c and confirm there is no hard-coded 'steady' string that conflicts with the new profile
The config_loader.c fallback to SIM_RANDOM_WALK for unknown strings still applies as a safe default — no change needed in default_config.c
If default_config.c contains any sim profile string other than 'random_walk', 'sine', or 'ramp', flag it in notes — do not change any values
